main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of forward 20-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and position-weighted mean excess > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean forward 20-bar excess return at age 5-20 (< 0)

decided_by: Slope t = 0.60 lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Used non-overlapping 20-bar blocks at window positions 0,20,40,... with plain OLS t over all grid bars (forecast 0 included), the coin benchmark as the mean of all its in-window forward 20-bar returns, position weights as postRebalance_current_allocation on the grid, and the supporting check on the same grid.
